title: Tanzanian Grilled Kingfish
author: Chef Jabir
desc: Tanzanian Grilled Kingfish — thick kingfish steaks marinated in lemon, garlic, and spices, grilled over charcoal until lightly charred and moist. Kingfish is the Indian Ocean's finest grilling fish — firm, flavourful, and magnificent over charcoal.
longDesc: Kingfish (Spanish mackerel) is the most prized grilling fish of the Tanzanian coast — its firm, oily flesh holds together perfectly over charcoal and develops a magnificent char without drying out.
steps: Mix marinade. Coat kingfish steaks thoroughly. Marinate 30 minutes.
Grill over medium-high coals for 6—8 minutes per side.
Do not move until fish releases from grill cleanly.
Garnish with coriander. Serve with lemon.
chefTips: Kingfish steaks are thicker — adjust time.
cookingScience: Kingfish has higher fat content than tilapia — intramuscular fat melts during grilling, naturally basting the fish from within.
sustainabilityTips: Indian Ocean kingfish from local coastal fishermen.
culturalNote: Grilled kingfish is the prized catch of the Tanzanian coast — the fish fishermen bring home for their families on important days.
